summary.zh: 设计欢迎、培育、引导与唤回邮件序列的节奏
summary.en: Design welcome, nurture and win-back email sequences with timing

description.zh: 为已订阅用户规划滴灌、培育、上手引导、欢迎和唤回邮件序列：定发送节奏、触发条件和退出规则，并逐封写出内容。适合新用户引导、长期培育或挽回沉默用户时使用。序列检查脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Plans drip, nurture, onboarding, welcome and win-back sequences for opted-in users: timing, triggers, exit rules and copy for each email. Use it for a new-user flow, a nurture track or winning back quiet subscribers. Needs Python.
